Comment.example: The first image file in the dataset.
Comment.title: 注释

ContentType.description_en: The MIME type of the file. It includes a type and a subtype
ContentType.title: image/jpeg

DataSize.description_en: The size of the file in bytes
DataSize.title: 文件大小，字节

FileCreateTime.description_en: The time when the file was created. The time is in ISO 8601 format
FileCreateTime.description_zh: 文件创建时间，格式：ISO8601格式
FileCreateTime.title: 创建时间，格式：ISO8601格式

FileFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the file. This value ensures the uniqueness of the file content and changes if the content is modified. For OSS files, this is the ETag. For NAS files, this is the MD5 value
FileFingerPrint.description_zh: 文件指纹值。用于确定文件内容的唯一性，文件内容修改后该值会发生变化。OSS文件使用ETag，NAS文件使用MD5值
FileFingerPrint.title: md5/oss etag

FileType.description_en: The type of the file. This is the same as the Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) type
FileType.title: 文件类型 image/audio/video/text

FileUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the file was last modified. The time is in ISO 8601 format
FileUpdateTime.description_zh: 文件最后修改时间，格式：ISO8601格式
FileUpdateTime.title: 修改时间，格式：ISO8601格式

MetaAttributes.description_en: The specific metadata of the file. This metadata cannot be used for retrieval. The value must be a JSON string
MetaAttributes.description_zh: 文件的特定元数据，暂不具备检索能力。JSON String格式
MetaAttributes.title: JSON String，存储文件的基础元数据，暂不具备检索能力

Tags.title: 标签组(json string)，仅更新user标签组

<details>

<summary>

</summary>

</details>

<details>

<summary>

NAS

</summary>

</details>

文件唯一URI。用于记录文件唯一路径。支持OSS、NAS下的文件路径。
